args.summary: Payment API errors began after this morning's deploy of payments-worker v3.4.0. Deployment history shows v3.4.0 marked unhealthy in production. Rolling back to the most recent healthy release, v3.3.0.
args.title: Payment errors following payments-worker v3.4.0 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Identified the service** — "payments" wasn't a registered service; your principal confirmed the actual service is **payments-worker** (the API errors were downstream of the worker).
2. **Found the bad release** — deployment history showed v3.4.0 was deployed this morning and marked **unhealthy**, while v3.3.0 was the last healthy production release.
3. **Rolled back** — payments-worker v3.3.0 was rolled out to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** — **INC-0001** ("Payment errors following payments-worker v3.4.0 deploy") is open and the on-call engineer has been paged.
5. **Verified recovery** — the service is now reporting healthy with an error rate of 0.2%.

One heads-up: since v3.4.0 has now been deployed once and failed, it will need change-manager approval before anyone attempts to redeploy it.
